notes.title: The Hungry Town | Chronicles #02
notes.content:
Hello, vampire story lovers! 🩸

Today I want to show you how [b]The Hungry Town[/b] has changed in a year and a half - from the first sketches to what you see now in the demo. I'm showing you the example of the diner and the characters: the main character Spike and his friend Stuart.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
It's no secret that I use the [b]MidJourney AI[/b] to create base images, which I then refine meticulously by hand.

[h3][b]How it began.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/310eaafd8e257d75e998d8c6726addc60be546d8.jpg[/img]
First sketch of the diner scene. (Spike on the left, Stuart on the right)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
[h3][b]What it looks like now, in the demo version.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/d22c955be771acd8fbefeecc4c43104187cddd03.jpg[/img]
Check out what can be achieved with polished visuals: every character has their own personality, the diner is detailed and beautifully collaged, and every element is in its proper place. Add some sound and visual effects, and you get a vivid, cohesive picture with its own unique atmosphere — exactly what I aimed to deliver in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
Share your thoughts in the comments — how do you like the changes? And how does the demo feel to play? If you haven’t stopped by Stuart’s diner yet, now is the perfect time to do it!🍔🩸
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
Oh, and take a look at how Spike looked originally — just a simple bald guy. And now he's a stylish vampire with sharp ears! 🧛🏼‍♂️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/5f9eb1df01423a69908d2243239ba0c0b773e1e4.jpg[/img]
Alexey Osh from [b]Kick Punch Games[/b]😎

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276460/The_Hungry_Town_Demo/

notes.title: The Hungry Town | Chronicles #01
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
This is Alex Osh, the developer of The Hungry Town game 🩸
It's the first news in the game's community, I called them - Chronicles! Sounds great!😎
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/d1501d142337c0ceeec64b3cb782c72686bcefd1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/a083a216ca485c891280253c144ae5b0335a39f0.png[/img]

Most of your kin are endowed with inhuman beauty and charm. You drew the short straw, losing your human form. With your new appearance, you are an outcast among humans and your kind. But the skills you acquired while still alive ensure your dignified existence in society.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/f1daf996577d844caf5276313564009b2dc7937f.png[/img]

But suddenly you receive a message that sets in motion a series of strange, confusing events involving a confrontation between two vampire clans.
Finding yourself between two fires, it's up to you to sort through the chaos, choose a side or stay true to yourself, and most importantly, survive in this Hungry Town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/11b9b7013396a406609c180f6f6548654c1b6c38.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Interactive visual novel with quest elements
[*] Full character voice acting
[*] Captivating story in the style of a detective thriller
[*] Deep atmosphere and musical accompaniment
[*] Beautiful graphics
[*] Memorable characters and locations
[*] Choices have consequences
[/list]
